gloss: water supply; pumping of water; water transmission

definitions.gloss: water supply; pumping or sending of water through pipes or hoses
definitions.explanation: The action of sending water from one place to another through pipes, hoses, or other conduits. Used for municipal water systems (sending water from a treatment plant to consumers), firefighting (pumping water through a hose to a fire), and industrial contexts. Can be used as a する verb.

examples.japanese: {送水|そうすい}が{止|と}まった。
{消防車|しょうぼうしゃ}からホースで{送水|そうすい}する。
examples.english: Water is pumped from the fire truck through the hose.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}の{影響|えいきょう}で{一時的|いちじてき}に{送水|そうすい}が{停止|ていし}されます。
examples.english: The water supply will be temporarily stopped due to construction.

examples.japanese: {浄水場|じょうすいじょう}から{各家庭|かくかてい}までの{送水|そうすい}ルートには{複数|ふくすう}のポンプ{施設|しせつ}が{含|ふく}まれている。
examples.english: The water-supply route from the treatment plant to individual homes includes several pump facilities.

notes:
Composed of {送|そう} (to send) and {水|すい} (water).

USAGE:
{送水|そうすい} is primarily a technical or infrastructural term used in announcements by water utilities, fire-department reports, and engineering contexts. It refers specifically to the action of moving water through a conduit. In everyday home conversation about having running water in the tap, {水道|すいどう} (plumbing, tap water) is more usual. {送水|そうすい} is a する-verb, so {送水|そうすい}する means "to pump / send water."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {送水|そうすい}する: to send / pump water
- {送水|そうすい}が{止|と}まる: the water supply stops
- {送水|そうすい}{管|かん}: water supply pipe
- {送水|そうすい}ポンプ: water pump (for supply)
- {送水|そうすい}{停止|ていし}: suspension of water supply

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {給水|きゅうすい}: water supply (to end users) — focuses on the delivery side, often used for supplying drinking water in emergencies or for a specific building
- {排水|はいすい}: drainage — the opposite direction, sending water out
- {取水|しゅすい}: water intake — taking water from a river or reservoir, the first stage of the water cycle
- {配水|はいすい}: water distribution — distributing the water within a municipal network (note: same pronunciation as {排水|はいすい} drainage)
